## Review Summary

This is a clean, well-scoped dead code removal. The PR mechanically strips the `rag_service` constructor parameter and its `self.rag_service` assignments from all eight strategy components, removes the five dead RAG methods from `OutlineChapterStrategy`, drops the `RAGIntegrationService` import from `strategy.py`, and updates `StrategyFactory.create_strategy_with_prompts()` consistently. All 10 new verification tests pass; the full suite remains green at 324 passed, 14 skipped.

One stale inline comment was left behind in `strategy.py`. One unguarded nullable-attribute call path in `OutlineGenerator` (the `rag_integration` attribute, distinct from the removed `rag_service` parameter) is a pre-existing latent bug not introduced by this PR but worth tracking.

**Files Reviewed:** 11
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 1 Warning, 2 Suggestion

## Phase 2 — Code Review

The parameter removal is complete and mechanically consistent across all eight `__init__` signatures:

- `OutlineChapterStrategy`
- `OutlineGenerator`
- `ChapterGenerator`
- `CharacterManager`
- `RecapManager`
- `SceneGenerator`
- `SettingManager`
- `StoryStateManager`

The five dead methods (`_initialize_rag_story`, `_purge_story_rag_content`, `get_rag_story_id`, `has_rag_story`, `get_rag_status`) are fully removed from `OutlineChapterStrategy`. The `RAGIntegrationService` import in `strategy.py` is gone. `StrategyFactory.create_strategy_with_prompts()` no longer accepts or forwards `rag_service`.

**[FINDING-01] Stale comment: "Store the prompt filename for RAG context"**
Category: Style
Severity: Warning
File: src/application/strategies/outline_chapter/strategy.py
Lines: 87
Description: The inline comment `# Store the prompt filename for RAG context` was not updated when the RAG integration was removed. The variable is now stored for savepoint management, not RAG context. This is an artifact of an incomplete cleanup pass during the `rag_service` removal.
Suggestion: Replace with `# Store the prompt filename for savepoint management` or simply remove the comment if it adds no value.

**[FINDING-02] Residual `rag_integration` attribute — separate dead-code layer**
Category: Correctness
Severity: Suggestion
File: src/application/strategies/outline_chapter/outline_generator.py (and character_manager.py, story_state_manager.py, chapter_generator.py, setting_manager.py)
Lines: general
Description: A distinct `self.rag_integration = None` attribute exists in these classes and is never set to a non-None value anywhere in the active codebase. Most usage sites guard with `if not self.rag_integration:`, which safely short-circuits. However, `OutlineGenerator._index_story_analysis_chunk()` (called from `_generate_story_analysis_chunks()`) calls `await self.rag_integration.index_outline(...)` without a null guard. If this code path executes, it will raise `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'index_outline'`. This bug pre-dates this PR and is not introduced here, but the PR's context (finishing the RAG removal work) makes it an appropriate time to flag.
Suggestion: File a follow-on issue to either (a) add a null guard to `_index_story_analysis_chunk` as an immediate safety fix, or (b) remove the entire `rag_integration` attribute and all its usage sites in a subsequent cleanup PR.

## Phase 5 — Testing Review

The new test file `tests/unit/test_rag_service_removal.py` provides 10 targeted verification tests:

- One test per class verifying `rag_service` absent from `__init__` signature (8 tests)
- One test on `StrategyFactory.create_strategy_with_prompts` (1 test)
- One test verifying all five dead methods absent from `OutlineChapterStrategy` (1 test)

All assertions use `inspect.signature()` and `hasattr()`, which test the live class definitions — a robust technique that will catch regressions if the parameter is reintroduced. Tests pass cleanly in isolation and as part of the full suite.

**[FINDING-03] E402 lint violations in new test file**
Category: Style
Severity: Suggestion
File: tests/unit/test_rag_service_removal.py
Lines: 17–25
Description: Ruff flags nine `E402 Module level import not at top of file` violations because the `sys.path.insert()` call at line 14 precedes the project imports. This is a pre-existing pattern shared by all other test files in the suite (`test_openai_compatible_provider.py`, `test_critique_service.py`, etc.), none of which suppress the warning with `# noqa: E402`. The new test file is consistent with the existing convention.
Suggestion: This is a project-wide pattern. The lowest-friction resolution is to add `# noqa: E402` to each affected import, or to configure `pyproject.toml` to exclude `tests/` from E402 checking (`[tool.ruff.per-file-ignores] "tests/**" = ["E402"]`). Either fix would apply retroactively to all test files.
